behaviors.description: Change progress notification cadence during a paced download.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent A/B app updates with over one MiB of new payload served at controlled speed.
behaviors.expected: 50ms/1000ms/50ms intervals each transfer the full payload; both fast runs produce more than twice the distinct in-transfer byte samples of the slow run; exact commits survive all resets.

mappings.rationale: A slow cadence is bracketed by two fast controls on repeated paced transfers, excluding zero and final duplicate samples.

surface_assertions.rationale: Contrasting requested intervals change the number of distinct advancing-byte notifications during equivalent payload transfers.

notes: This compares observable notification cadence without requiring exact scheduling or callback counts.
